#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
#include <cstdint>
using namespace std;
using ll = int64_t;
using pll = pair<ll, ll>;

ll comb[62][62], A[32][32], B[32][32], TT;
int R, C, n;
char p[110];
ll CC[32][32], MM;
vector<pll> P[32][2], Q[32][2];

void put(int x, int y, ll g, ll c1, ll c2, int ck) {
    if (x + y == R + n) {
        P[x][ck].push_back({g, c1});
        if (c2) Q[x][ck].push_back({g, c2});
        return;
    }
    put(x + 1, y, g + (!ck ? A[x + 1][y] : 0), c1, (p[x + y] != 'B' ? c2 : 0), ck);
    put(x, y + 1, g + (ck ? B[x][y + 1] : 0), c1, (p[x + y] != 'A' ? c2 : 0), ck);
}

void calc1(int x, int y, ll g, int ck) {
    if (x + y == R + n) {
        if (P[x][ck].empty()) return;
        int t = lower_bound(P[x][ck].begin(), P[x][ck].end(), pll((TT + 1) / 2 - g, 0)) - P[x][ck].begin();
        if (t != (int)P[x][ck].size() && P[x][ck][t].second > 0) {
            ll tp = (P[x][ck][t].first + g) * 2 - TT;
            if (tp < 0) tp = -tp;
            if (MM > tp) MM = tp;
        }
        if (t && P[x][ck][t - 1].second > 0) {
            ll tp = (P[x][ck][t - 1].first + g) * 2 - TT;
            if (tp < 0) tp = -tp;
            if (MM > tp) MM = tp;
        }
        return;
    }
    calc1(x - 1, y, g + (!ck ? A[x][y] : 0), ck);
    calc1(x, y - 1, g + (ck ? B[x][y] : 0), ck);
}

ll Res;

void calc2(int x, int y, ll g, int ck) {
    if (x + y == R + n) {
        int t = lower_bound(Q[x][ck].begin(), Q[x][ck].end(), pll((TT + 1) / 2 - g, 0)) - Q[x][ck].begin();
        if (t != (int)Q[x][ck].size() && Q[x][ck][t].second > 0) {
            ll tp = (Q[x][ck][t].first + g) * 2 - TT;
            if (tp < 0) tp = -tp;
            if (MM == tp) Res += Q[x][ck][t].second;
        }
        if (t && Q[x][ck][t - 1].second > 0) {
            ll tp = (Q[x][ck][t - 1].first + g) * 2 - TT;
            if (tp < 0) tp = -tp;
            if (MM == tp) Res += Q[x][ck][t - 1].second;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (p[x + y - 1] != 'B') calc2(x - 1, y, g + (!ck ? A[x][y] : 0), ck);
    if (p[x + y - 1] != 'A') calc2(x, y - 1, g + (ck ? B[x][y] : 0), ck);
}

void make(vector<pll>& vec) {
    if (vec.empty()) return;
    sort(vec.begin(), vec.end());
    int cnt = 0;
    ll s = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
        s += vec[i].second;
        if (i + 1 == vec.size() || vec[i].first != vec[i + 1].first) {
            vec[cnt++] = {vec[i].first, s};
            s = 0;
        }
    }
    vec.resize(cnt);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    cin >> R >> C;
    cin >> p;
    for (int i = 0; i <= 60; ++i) {
        comb[i][0] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j)
            comb[i][j] = comb[i - 1][j - 1] + comb[i - 1][j];
    }
    n = R + C;
    TT = comb[n * 2][R * 2];

        for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) {
            if (i) A[i][j] = comb[i - 1][R - 1] * (comb[n * 2 - i][R] - comb[j][R]);
            if (j) B[i][j] = comb[j - 1][R - 1] * (comb[n * 2 - j][R] - comb[i][R]);
        }
    }
    CC[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) {
            if (i != n && p[i + j] != 'B') CC[i + 1][j] += CC[i][j];
            if (j != n && p[i + j] != 'A') CC[i][j + 1] += CC[i][j];
        }
    }
    for (int i = R; i <= n; ++i) {
        if (p[i + R - 1] != 'B') put(R, i, A[R][i], comb[i + R - 1][R - 1], CC[R - 1][i], 0);
        if (p[i + R - 1] != 'A') put(i, R, B[i][R], comb[i + R - 1][R - 1], CC[i][R - 1], 1);
    }
    for (int i = R; i <= n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 2; ++j) {
            make(P[i][j]);
            make(Q[i][j]);
        }
    }
    MM = TT + 1;
    calc1(n, n, 0, 0);
    calc1(n, n, 0, 1);
    calc2(n, n, 0, 0);
    calc2(n, n, 0, 1);
    cout << Res << '\n';
    return 0;
}
